script: When she asks how was your day, never reply, "Good." "Yours?" She's not asking for a report. She's asking for a reason to keep talking. Try one of these four. And stay until the last one. Number one: Better now that you asked. She knows she made your day. Number two: Long day, but I saved the best part for last: talking to you. No complaining, no boring details, just a compliment. Number three: Interesting. I'll tell you everything, but only over coffee. That's curiosity, and it turns a simple question into a date. Number four: It was missing something, and it just texted me. Comment the word DAY, and I'll send you my free playbook.
